slug: 2026-07-15 Raxio data-centre capital tops $380m on investor boost

facts.fact: Raxio, an independent pan-African data-centre operator, is stated on 13 July 2026 to operate carrier-neutral data-centre facilities in Uganda (among six countries); the article names no Ugandan facility and gives no opening date, so the date is the statement's.

The article states, as the operator's own claim reported by Tech.africa on 13 July 2026, that Raxio operates Tier III carrier-neutral facilities in Uganda; no Uptime Institute or TIA-942 certification is cited and no facility is named; the date is the statement's.

note: carried from datacentres; no document opened
